valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: KPLC-P4 is a Kenya Power 4% PREFERENCE share class. The profit, revenue and equity on file are Kenya Power & Lighting's whole enterprise (identical to the KPLC common-share file), while the market capitalisation is only this class's KSh 9,468,000 of paid-up preference capital. Dividing the common enterprise's profit by a preference class's capital is not a valuation of that instrument. A blank is honest; a number built from a different capital base is not.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the equity on file is the whole of Kenya Power's common equity (109,335,566,000), not this preference class's book value, and the market capitalisation is the preference class's KSh 9,468,000. A ratio over two different capital bases is not a valuation. A blank is honest.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: Kenya Power 4% Preference Shares is a preference share - a fixed-dividend preferred claim, not an ordinary share, so a P/E, P/B or P/S built on the issuer's ordinary earnings, book value or revenue is not a valuation of this instrument. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
